  Analysis of the AI-flagged complaints shows that they are more citation-dense, disproportionately associated with first-time rather than repeat filers, and geographically unevenly distributed. This composition pattern suggests that AI-consistent drafting is not merely a repeat-filer phenomenon; it also includes a modest, suggestive increase in name-inferred female plaintiffs. We find no evidence of improved win rates; in fact, AI-flagged complaints are more likely to be dismissed and to terminate at earlier procedural phases. These findings raise new questions about access to justice and court screening burdens, and sharpen the distinction between legal formality and legal efficacy.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察生成式AI普及后联邦民事诉讼中自诉原告的增加现象。使用约280万份案件数据发现Pro se原告率上升5.61个百分点，其中通过AI检测指标识别的AI一致性起草投诉占13.9%。分析表明AI辅助起草主要影响首次起诉者且地理分布不均，但并未改善诉讼结果——AI标记投诉反而更易被驳回，引发司法公正获取和法院负担问题。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI工具的普及可能改变人们诉讼的方式——更多人选择自诉(Self-represented)，可能借助AI起草诉状。
AI.method: 使用FY2008-2025年约280万份民事案件数据，比较GenAI前后时期的变化；采用 stylometric AI检测指标开发可解释的AI一致性起草测量方法；将案件元数据与Pro se投诉进行关联分析。
AI.result: 联邦民事Pro se原告率从GenAI前的11.33%上升至GenAI后的16.94%（增加5.61个百分点）；AI标记的非格式投诉占比达13.9%；AI标记投诉具有更高引用密度、更多首次起诉者、地理分布不均等特点；AI标记投诉更易被驳回、在更早程序阶段终止。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现AI辅助起草的投诉并没有提高胜诉率，反而更可能被驳回、在更早的程序阶段终止。这项研究揭示了生成式AI对司法程序的影响，提出关于司法公正获取和法院筛选负担的新问题，并强调法律形式与法律效力之间的区别。

title: Silent Data Corruption Protection through Efficient Task Replication
summary:
The trend of increasing cluster sizes of supercomputers leads to a growing susceptibility to Silent Data Corruption (SDC) that can invalidate program results. A common strategy for SDC protection is replication, where the computation is repeated, and the correct result is determined as the one that is the same in at least two different computations. Applying replication to Asynchronous Many-Task (AMT) runtimes on clusters is challenging due to dynamic task spawning and work stealing, which complicate the identification of replicated tasks.
  To address the challenge, this paper introduces a novel replication scheme that detects and corrects SDCs for nested fork-join programs. Briefly stated, our approach replicates the computation and records the task tree. Upon a mismatch in the final result, it traverses the tree top-down to identify all corrupted tasks that could have impacted the final result. Recovery is then performed by recomputing these tasks, while the results of correct child tasks are reused.
  We demonstrate our implementation within a variant of the Itoyori cluster AMT runtime. Our experimental results suggest that the time to identify and reprocess the affected tasks is negligible. The paper concludes by discussing the adaptability of our scheme to tasks that cooperate through futures.

AI.tldr: 针对异步多任务运行时中的静默数据损坏问题，提出基于任务树记录的复制检测与选择性恢复方案，在Itoyori运行时中验证有效且开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: 超算集群规模增长导致静默数据损坏(SDC)敏感性增加，而AMT运行时中的动态任务生成和工作窃取机制使传统复制保护策略难以直接应用。
AI.method: 提出一种新型复制方案，核心包括：(1)复制计算并记录任务树结构；(2)最终结果不匹配时，自顶向下遍历识别所有可能影响结果的损坏任务；(3)仅重新计算受损任务，复用正确子任务结果。
AI.result: 在Itoyori集群AMT运行时中实现该方案，实验表明识别和重新处理受影响任务的时间可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 该方案可扩展至通过futures协作的任务，在Itoyori实现中，识别和重新处理受影响任务的时间开销可忽略不计，验证了方法的有效性。

title: DynaGraph: Lightweight Multi-Model Interaction Framework via Dynamic Topological Reconfiguration
summary: Tackling complex reasoning tasks typically relies on massive monolithic LLMs, which suffer from severe computational redundancy. While task decomposition through structured pipelines or multi-agent collaborations offers an alternative, these approaches inevitably fall into a critical dilemma: predefined static topologies are highly vulnerable to cascading errors, whereas unconstrained dynamic agents suffer from trajectory divergence and unpredictable memory bloat. To address this, we present DynaGraph, a lightweight multi-model framework driven by dynamic topological reconfiguration. At the execution level, DynaGraph multiplexes time-division PEFT adapters over a shared base model, enabling both full system training and inference deployment on a single consumer-grade GPU. At the routing level, the Evaluator continuously monitors execution confidence to trigger hierarchical self-healing: Fine-grained Patching for localized data gaps and Subgraph Reconstruction for severe logical ruptures. Experiments on StrategyQA, MATH, and FinQA demonstrate our 8B model closely approximates the reasoning capabilities of a 72B monolithic model (e.g., 87.6% on StrategyQA, 82.7% on MATH). Furthermore, it reduces latency by up to 68.1% and token consumption by 68.6% compared to unconstrained dynamic architectures.

AI.tldr: DynaGraph addresses the trade-off between static and dynamic multi-model reasoning by combining time-division PEFT adapters with hierarchical self-healing mechanisms, achieving near-state-of-the-art performance with 8B parameters while significantly reducing computational costs.
AI.motivation: Complex reasoning tasks typically rely on massive monolithic LLMs, which suffer from severe computational redundancy. Existing task decomposition approaches (structured pipelines or multi-agent collaborations) face a critical dilemma: predefined static topologies are vulnerable to cascading errors, whereas unconstrained dynamic agents suffer from trajectory divergence and unpredictable memory bloat.
AI.method: 1. Execution Level: Multiplexes time-division PEFT adapters over a shared base model, enabling full system training and inference on a single consumer-grade GPU. 2. Routing Level: An Evaluator continuously monitors execution confidence and triggers hierarchical self-healing: Fine-grained Patching for localized data gaps and Subgraph Reconstruction for severe logical ruptures.
AI.result: DynaGraph's 8B model closely approximates the reasoning capabilities of a 72B monolithic model (87.6% on StrategyQA, 82.7% on MATH). Additionally, it reduces latency by up to 68.1% and token consumption by 68.6% compared to unconstrained dynamic architectures.
AI.conclusion: DynaGraph's dynamic reconfiguration approach successfully addresses the trade-off between static pipeline rigidity and dynamic agent chaos, offering a practical solution that balances reasoning capability with computational efficiency for resource-constrained deployments.

title: A Modular Architecture for Typologically Controlled Lexicon Generation
summary: Constructing artificial lexicons that are pronounceable, typologically plausible, and semantically structured remains an open challenge in computational linguistics. Existing conlang generators either lack formal phonotactic guarantees or delegate generation to opaque, non-reproducible LLM-based pipelines. We propose a modular framework that samples phoneme inventories from PHOIBLE, generates word forms under interchangeable phonological grammars (deterministic, OT, and MaxEnt), and assigns meanings via a Swadesh--Leipzig--Jakarta ontology with explicit form--meaning alignment. Evaluation on character $n$-gram perplexity, log-likelihood, and KL divergence against PHOIBLE across lexicon sizes of 100-5,000 forms shows that probabilistic grammars consistently outperform deterministic and random baselines on both phonotactic coherence and typological realism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个模块化人工语言构建框架，从PHOIBLE数据库采样音位清单，通过可替换的音系语法生成词形，并使用Swadesh-Leipzig-Jakarta本体分配语义。实验表明概率语法（OT、MaxEnt）在100-5000词规模上始终优于确定性基线和随机基线。
AI.motivation: Existing conlang generators lack formal phonotactic guarantees or rely on opaque, non-reproducible LLM-based pipelines, failing to produce lexicons that are simultaneously pronounceable, typologically plausible, and semantically structured.
AI.method: The proposed framework consists of three modular components: (1) sampling phoneme inventories from the PHOIBLE database; (2) generating word forms using interchangeable phonological grammars (deterministic, OT, and MaxEnt); and (3) assigning meanings via a Swadesh–Leipzig–Jakarta ontology with explicit form-meaning alignment. Evaluation metrics include character n-gram perplexity, log-likelihood, and KL divergence.
AI.result: Across lexicon sizes of 100–5,000 forms, probabilistic grammars consistently outperform deterministic and random baselines on both phonotactic coherence and typological realism.
AI.conclusion: Probabilistic grammars (OT, MaxEnt) outperform deterministic and random baselines across lexicon sizes of 100–5,000 forms, demonstrating superior phonotactic coherence and typological realism.

title: Mechanistic origins of catastrophic forgetting: why RL preserves circuits better than SFT?
summary: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) frequently induces catastrophic forgetting of prior capabilities. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning (RL) retains prior capabilities more effectively than supervised fine-tuning (SFT), attributing this to policy-gradient updates remaining closer to the base policy \cite{shenfeld2025rl}. We extend this behavioral account to the mechanistic level and ask whether RL's advantage is mirrored by stronger preservation of internal computational circuits. We introduce differential circuit vulnerability, a head-level measure of how much a circuit degrades under fine-tuning, and use it to compare RL and SFT on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct adapted to scientific question-answering. We find a clear mechanistic trade-off: SFT adapts more rapidly to the target task but produces substantially greater circuit disruption and forgetting of prior capabilities, whereas RL preserves a larger fraction of the base circuit at the cost of slower task adaptation. These findings suggest that circuit preservation may help explain why RL is more robust to catastrophic forgetting. We released our code here: https://github.com/rl-sft-circuit-research/differential-circuit-vulnerability.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次从机械（mechanistic）层面验证了RL在对抗灾难性遗忘中的优势，通过引入"差分电路脆弱性"指标，发现RL通过更好地保留基础模型的内部计算电路来维持先验能力，而SFT虽然适应快但会显著破坏原有电路结构。
AI.motivation: SFT虽能快速适应目标任务，但会导致严重的基础模型能力遗忘；RL在保持先验能力方面表现更优，但其底层机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出"差分电路脆弱性"指标，在Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct模型上，通过比较RL微调和SFT在科学问答任务中各注意力头电路的退化程度，量化评估两种方法对模型内部计算电路的影响。
AI.result: SFT在目标任务上收敛更快，但造成更严重的电路破坏和能力遗忘；RL则更好地保留了基础模型的电路结构，但任务适应速度较慢。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了RL在保持基础模型电路结构方面的内在优势，为理解RL抗灾难性遗忘的机制提供了电路级别的证据，表明电路保存率可作为评估微调方法的指标。

title: The Cognitive Categorical Transformer: Category-Theoretic Inductive Biases for Language Modeling
summary: The Cognitive Categorical Transformer (CCT) is a 306M-parameter architecture that augments a pretrained GPT-2 Small backbone with cognitively grounded components derived from category theory and several inspirations from cognitive science. Under a matched-step protocol (215,000 optimizer steps, matched data, matched optimizer and schedule) on WikiText-103, CCT reaches 21.27 validation perplexity, compared with 24.19 for an identically fine-tuned GPT-2 Small baseline. The architecture therefore contributes a 2.92 PPL (12% relative) reduction beyond what in-domain fine-tuning alone provides. A retrain-from-scratch ablation that holds GT-Full simplicial message passing bypassed across the entire seven-phase activation schedule reaches 23.72 PPL, localizing 84% of the architectural improvement (2.45 of 2.92 PPL) to GT-Full. We present the first ablation-validated evidence that simplicial message passing improves language-model perplexity at the 306M-parameter scale on WikiText-103. Published GPT-2 Large reaches 22.05 zero-shot PPL on WikiText-103 with 6.2x more parameters than GPT-2 Small; this paper treats that number as an external published reference, not as the architectural benchmark. Three negative results on consistency-style categorical priors (sheaf smoothing, adjunction round-trip, curvature regularization) and the joint structural-prior result for GT-Full and PrecisionWeightedPP together support an empirical pattern termed the *structure/consistency distinction*, in which categorical priors that add new topology improve language modeling and those that enforce a consistency identity do not.

AI.tldr: CCT, a 306M-parameter architecture combining GPT-2 Small with category theory and cognitive science components, achieves 21.27 PPL on WikiText-103 (12% improvement over baseline). GT-Full simplicial message passing is identified as the primary contributor (84% of improvement). Negative results on consistency-style priors reveal the "structure/consistency distinction": topological priors improve language modeling while consistency-enforcing priors do not.
AI.motivation: Enhance language models with cognitively grounded components from category theory and cognitive science to improve perplexity beyond standard fine-tuning.
AI.method: CCT augments GPT-2 Small (306M parameters) with cognitively grounded components from category theory. Key contributor: GT-Full simplicial message passing. Matched-step protocol (215,000 steps) for fair comparison. Ablations include bypass of GT-Full across all seven-phase activation schedule.
AI.result: CCT reaches 21.27 PPL vs 24.19 baseline (2.92 PPL reduction). GT-Full ablation shows 23.72 PPL, localizing 84% of improvement to simplicial message passing. Consistency-style priors (sheaf smoothing, adjunction round-trip, curvature regularization) yield negative results.
AI.conclusion: CCT achieves 21.27 PPL on WikiText-103 (12% relative improvement over baseline), with GT-Full simplicial message passing accounting for 84% of improvement. Negative results on consistency-style priors (sheaf smoothing, adjunction round-trip, curvature regularization) support the "structure/consistency distinction" hypothesis.

title: On Language Generation in the Limit with Bounded Memory
comment: The abstract has been shortened to fit within the arXiv limit
summary:
We study language generation in the limit under bounded memory. In this task, a learner observes examples from an unknown target language one at a time and must eventually output only new valid examples. Prior work assumes access to the entire history, a strong assumption since realistic algorithms retain limited past information. Classical work in learning theory shows memory constraints dramatically alter learnability; we extend this to language generation.
  First, we study memoryless generators. Under a mild enumeration restriction, every countable collection of infinite languages remains generable without memory. Without this restriction, we exactly characterize when memoryless generation is possible. For finite collections, we characterize the optimal minimax density achievable by memoryless generators -- the best density guaranteed against any collection of a given size. This combinatorial bound relies on Sperner's theorem and symmetric chain decompositions.
  We further show that a sliding window of the last $W$ examples does not improve this worst-case density, whereas allowing it to store $b$ adaptively chosen past examples improves the achievable density for every $b \geq 1$.
  Finally, we revisit identification in the limit, where the learner must converge to a single correct hypothesis for the target language. We focus on its incremental variant, where the learner remembers only its previous guess. Here, although exact identification fails on a collection of just three languages, a mild relaxation requiring convergence to an ``approximate'' version of the target is achievable for every finite collection.
  These results show bounded memory affects these tasks differently: generation remains achievable for every countable collection, while density and identification are confined to finite collections, with guarantees weakening as the collection grows.

AI.tldr: 研究在有限内存条件下语言的极限学习。传统学习理论假设可访问全部历史记录，但现实算法记忆有限。研究表明：在轻微枚举限制下，每个可数语言集合仍可无内存生成；无此限制时，精确刻画何时可实现无内存生成；对于有限集合，刻画了无内存生成器可实现的最优最小化密度；滑动窗口不能改善最坏情况密度，但自适应存储可改善；增量识别在三个语言集合上精确识别失败，但放松到"近似"版本则可行。
AI.motivation: 传统学习理论假设学习者可访问完整历史记录，但现实算法只能保留有限的过去信息。内存约束如何改变可学习性是核心问题，本文将此扩展到语言生成任务。
AI.method: 1. 研究无内存生成器，在轻微枚举限制下分析可数无穷语言集合的可生成性；2. 使用Sperner定理和对称链分解等组合工具刻画有限集合的最优最小化密度；3. 比较滑动窗口模型与自适应存储模型的表现差异；4. 研究增量识别变体（仅记忆前一次猜测）。
AI.result: 1. 在轻微枚举限制下，每个可数语言集合均可无内存生成；2. 无此限制时，精确刻画了可实现无内存生成的条件；3. 对于有限集合，确定了无内存生成器可实现的最优最小化密度；4. 最后W个样本的滑动窗口不能改善最坏情况密度；5. 自适应存储b个过去样本可改善任意b≥1时的可实现密度；6. 精确增量识别在仅三个语言的集合上就失败，但放松到"近似"目标可对所有有限集合达成。
AI.conclusion: 有限内存对不同任务的影响各异：生成任务对所有可数集合仍可实现，而密度优化和精确识别仅限于有限集合，且随集合增大保证减弱。这表明在设计实际学习算法时需根据具体任务特性选择合适的内存模型。

title: Towards Reliable Agentic Progressive Text-to-Visualization with Verification Rules
summary: Text-to-Visualization (Text-to-Vis) translates natural language queries into visualization query languages, enabling non-expert users to perform data analysis. However, most existing methods follow a one-shot paradigm that requires users to specify all visualization details in a single round, often leading to cognitive overload and incorrect visualizations. In this paper, we propose PMVis, a progressive multi-turn paradigm for text-to-vis, where users' intents are refined through multi-turn interactions. To support research in this paradigm, we construct PMVisBench, the first dataset designed to capture the progressive and iterative nature of real-world user queries. It is built through VQL simplification and NLQ reconstruction, with explicit rule constraints to ensure each intermediate VQL remains valid and meaningful. Building upon PMVis, we further introduce PMVisAgent, an agent-based framework that simulates realistic user-system dialogues. PMVisAgent consists of a User, a System, and a Validation Agent that performs verification and repair via a ReAct-style tool-use loop to mitigate error accumulation across rounds, with explicit interaction and verification rules to ensure reliability of the multi-agent system. Extensive experiments on PMVisBench demonstrate that PMVisAgent significantly outperforms state-of-the-art text-to-vis baselines. It achieves up to 17.57\% and 23.21\% improvements in execution accuracy in single-table and multi-table settings, respectively, while ablation studies confirm the importance of combining progressive interaction with clarification. The code is available at https://github.com/wxxv/PMVis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PMVis渐进式多轮文本到可视化范式及PMVisAgent智能体框架，通过多轮交互、验证与修复机制缓解认知过载和错误累积，在PMVisBench数据集上显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到可视化方法采用单轮范式，要求用户一次性指定所有可视化细节，导致认知负担过重和可视化错误
AI.method: 构建PMVisBench数据集(通过VQL简化和NLQ重构)；设计PMVisAgent框架(包含User、System和Validation Agent三个角色)；采用ReAct风格工具调用循环进行验证和修复；引入显式交互和验证规则确保系统可靠性
AI.result: PMVisAgent在单表和多表设置中分别实现17.57%和23.21%的执行准确率提升，消融实验验证了渐进式交互与澄清结合的重要性
AI.conclusion: PMVisAgent通过多智能体协作架构显著提升了文本到可视化任务的准确性和可靠性，消融实验证实了渐进式交互与澄清结合的重要性。

title: Converted, Not Equivalent: Benchmarking Codebase Conversion via Observational Equivalence
summary: Coding agents increasingly act as codebase-scale collaborators that can assist with codebase conversion, but this progress has exposed a critical weakness: agents often over-trust their own local validation routines and declare success on artifacts that satisfy surface checks while violating the semantic contracts users actually care about. This problem is especially acute in codebase conversion, where prior evaluation is largely outcome-driven and therefore unstable: two implementations can match on a shallow outcome, such as a single forward loss, while diverging in gradients, optimizer behavior, or short-horizon training dynamics. We introduce T2J-Bench, a benchmark for codebase conversion that reformulates conversion as transfer under a fixed equivalence contract. A fixed verifier then compares source and converted codebases through three ordered stages: Spec (interface admissibility), Numeric (forward outputs, losses, gradients, and objective-specific tensors), and Behavioral (short training dynamics under fixed seeds). Across 355 blind conversion attempts, the best system reaches only 26.7--28.9% overall pass rate despite Spec pass rates up to 91.1%; a 4.7x token-budget spread yields only a 2.2x pass-rate spread; and all systems overestimate success by 66.6--97.8 points relative to the fixed evaluator. This suggests that failures stem more from contract-misaligned self-validation than from limited budget or backbone strength.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 T2J-Bench：一个面向 PyTorch→JAX 全仓库迁移的基准（63 个任务、18 个模型族，覆盖 SFT/DPO/PPO 训练与 vLLM 式 paged-attention 服务），把"代码库转换"重新定义为在固定等价契约下的"迁移"；评分在独立、离线、已移除 PyTorch 的验证器中执行，依次检查 Spec（接口/结构/独立性）、Numeric（前向、损失、梯度、张量）、Behavioral（固定种子下的训练动态与解码行为），并以 Spec 为乘法门控的无阈值连续奖励 R = s_spec×(0.5·s_num+0.5·s_beh)。此外提出 TwinHarness——把可执行的 PyTorch 源码当作"可执行规格"的诊断—迁移—验证循环，仅用任务可见信息给出反馈。二十种现成 agent–模型配置中最好仅达 0.676（oracle 0.980），TwinHarness 将 opus-5 的奖励从 0.649 提升到 0.723，为最高分。
AI.motivation: （1）现有代码/迁移基准（HumanEval、SWE-bench、CodeXGLUE、MigrationBench 等）要么只看单元测试通过率、要么只看与参考翻译的表面相似度，无法刻画"迁移后行为是否等价"；PyTorch→JAX 是跨范式改写（eager/有状态/面向对象 → 纯函数 + 显式 pytree、原地 KV cache → 显式状态），逐行转写与正确性不等价。（2）JAX 重实现可以"秘密导入 PyTorch"伪造等价，因此评测必须建立源框架独立性。（3）编码 agent 普遍过度信任自建的本地校验脚本，对只满足表面检查、却违反语义契约的产物宣告成功；此前基于结果的评测（如单次前向 loss）不稳定，梯度、优化器行为、短程训练动态可能被忽略。（4）已有相邻工作（Liang et al. 2026 的 agentic 迁移、JAXBench 的 Pallas 内核优化）要么人工评定、要么只评算子级正确性与加速比，缺少自动化的全仓库、含训练与服务行为的等价性基准。
AI.method: 【基准 T2J-Bench】63 个全仓库任务：训练类 15 模型族×{SFT,DPO,PPO}=45 个 LoRA 微调任务（源自 LLaMA-Factory，24 文本/21 视觉）；服务类 6 族×{core, ragged, chunked-prefill}=18 个 vLLM 风格 paged-attention 引擎任务（源自 vLLM/tpu-inference）。每任务给出约 15–20 模块的纯 PyTorch 源码树与原始 checkpoint，agent 须产出镜像文件布局与公共接口的原生 JAX/Flax 仓库，并自行实现无 PyTorch 的权重转换。评测在独立、离线、torch-free 的验证器内进行，参考值一律由原始 PyTorch 程序在固定 H100、fp32 下记录（oracle provenance），参考 JAX 方案只作为"候选"而非真值。【等价晶格与奖励】七级 L0–L6（独立性/结构 → 模块算子 → 组合前向 → 泛化 → 机制（损失/梯度 或 逐步解码）→ 端到端训练/服务 → 留出集泛化），后一级依赖前一级；每检查归入 Spec（通过/不通过）/Numeric（连续相似度）/Behavioral 三类，L0 为 Spec 乘法门，L1–L4 计入 Numeric，L5–L6 计入 Behavioral。五种内在有界、无阈值的相似度（scalar、ℓ2、cos、tensor=√(cos·ℓ2)、JSD 分布距离），浮点噪声上限约 0.999；崩溃、NaN、PyTorch 泄漏或超出时间预算（约为原实现耗时 2 倍）一律该检查记 0；L6 采用由 PyTorch 原生 run-to-run 波动确定的"带状"标量度量。【TwinHarness】diagnose–migrate–verify 循环：诊断器基于差异探测（用 PyTorch 原仓库作外部行为锚点）+ 候选侧检查（可导入性、禁用依赖、pytree 参数树、梯度活性、JAX tracing、训练/服务入口）产出证据，标签为 established / violated / not established，并跨迭代保留证据与"保持约束"；验证器只能读不能改，输出 qa_report.json。严格信息边界：仅使用 instruction.md、torch_orig/、checkpoint 与候选仓库，绝不接触隐藏测试、冻结参考、验证器代码、参考 JAX 方案与奖励；最终评分管线与基线完全相同。实验：5 种 agent 脚手架（Claude-Code、OpenHands、Gemini-CLI、OpenCode、Terminus-2）× 各模型共 20 个现成配置，63 任务 × 3 随机种子，每任务 3 小时/单 H100，另做 1–3 轮续跑的成本—奖励分析、跨脚手架消融、任务级细化稳定性与失败分类学。
AI.result: （1）现成配置远未饱和：最佳 OpenCode+opus-5 奖励 0.676±0.014，Claude-Code+opus-5 0.649，OpenHands+opus-5 0.622，Terminus-2 最好 0.369，Gemini-CLI 各配置 0.057–0.102；oracle 参考 JAX 方案 0.980（训练类 0.973、推理类 0.997），差距 0.304。（2）高 Spec 通过率不等于语义等价：最佳配置 Spec 0.927，但 Numeric 0.670、Behavioral 0.741；推理类奖励（0.499）普遍远低于训练类（0.747）；PPO 是所有配置的最弱子型（0.538–0.620，oracle 0.988）。（3）TwinHarness+opus-5 达 0.723±0.022，为全表最高；相对同模型 Claude-Code 提升 0.074（+11.4%：Spec +0.007、Numeric +0.112、Behavior +0.064、训练 +0.039、推理 +0.165），相对最强现成配置提升 0.047（+7.0%）；在 4 组脚手架–模型配对上一致提升 0.059–0.130（Claude-Code/sonnet-5 0.408→0.467，Gemini-CLI/3.7-flash 0.102→0.222，3.8-flash 0.087→0.217）。（4）"更多迭代"不等于更好：普通续跑使 OpenCode 从 0.676 降至 0.628 再降至约 0.60，Claude-Code 仅 0.649→0.658；在与 TwinHarness 相当的 API 成本下，普通续跑仅约 0.66/0.60，留 0.06–0.12 差距；任务级看，普通续跑退化 22/63 任务，而 TwinHarness 仅退化 2/63（改善 11 个）。两轮时 TwinHarness 0.723 反超 OpenCode 基线 0.078。（5）失败分类学显示 TwinHarness 的收益集中在"可执行可见"的失败：shape mismatch 降约 86%、生成/KV-cache 失败降 23%、无梯度不匹配记录；而参数树不匹配、批处理 schema、JAX/Torch 边界与方法级数值偏差仍显著（表 5 中 TwinHarness 在参数树+1.3、批处理+2.3、边界+2.3 上反而略差）。（6）子型结果不均：TwinHarness 在 DPO/PPO/chunked 领先，Claude-Code 保留最高 SFT（0.854）与 ragged（0.604/0.626），OpenCode+opus-5 领先 core 推理（0.742 vs 0.623）；TwinHarness 的 SFT 反而从 0.854 降到 0.821。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是：代码库转换的失败主因不是预算或骨干模型强度，而是"契约错位的自验证"——agent 用自己的浅层检查替代了语义等价判据；因此把转换重述为"在固定等价契约下的迁移"，用执行落地（execution-grounded）的等价性（而非表面相似或单元测试数）来评分，是提升可靠跨框架迁移的关键。此外，把可执行的源实现转化为"参考锚定的反馈"（TwinHarness）可以在不触碰隐藏评测状态的前提下显著改善迁移质量：诊断-迁移-验证循环的收益随迭代累积、显著减少细化过程中的回退，而不仅是"多写几轮"。局限与边界：作者明确声明高分只覆盖被评分的晶格前缀——多模态"完全注意力"数值、多模态子模块 parity、音频通路（仅检查存在性）、训练类中的精确逐 token 生成（改用 tie-robust 分布）、首步之后的 LoRA 梯度幅值、以及跨硬件可移植性均不在覆盖范围；评测固定单一 H100。论文也自陈若干归因限制：续跑同时改变编辑与算力，无法隔离 token 预算效应；TwinHarness 各组件（差异诊断 vs 候选侧检查、角色分离、提示结构）的独立因果贡献未被隔离；任务级比较中两种方法各自从自己的首轮候选出发；结论仅在已评测配置与任务分布内成立，未证明对未见任务分布的泛化。值得注意的是，给出的"摘要"（355 次盲测、26.7–28.9% 通过率、Spec 91.1%、4.7× token 预算只带来 2.2× 通过率、agent 高估 66.6–97.8 分）与正文 T2J-Bench 的数据体系并不一致，读者应以 arXiv 正文（T2J-Bench 全文）为准并核对版本。

title: CrossAlpha: An Annual-Report Benchmark for Cross-Market Factor Research
summary: Cross-market factor research studies whether firm-level signals from one or more markets can predict returns in a target market, but existing public benchmarks do not support cross-market disclosure-to-return evaluation. Building such a benchmark is challenging because filings differ across languages and regulatory systems, disclosure-derived similarity can be biased by common reporting components, and cross-market signals must be evaluated under feasible trading-time alignment. We introduce \textbf{CrossAlpha}, a public annual-report benchmark for cross-market factor research. CrossAlpha addresses these challenges through three corresponding components: \emph{Disclosure Distillation}, which standardises heterogeneous filings into ten-category English business descriptions; \emph{Residual Schema Graph Construction}, which builds PCA-whitened cross-market firm-pair scores from schema-level disclosures; and \emph{Timing-Aligned Evaluation}, which pairs the graph with 11 years of daily OHLCV data to construct forward-return labels under feasible cross-market execution protocols. CrossAlpha covers about 3,600 firms and 10,700 firm-year reports from the United States, Japan, Taiwan, South Korea, and Hong Kong, and releases about 19M directed firm-pair scores. In experiments, disclosure-derived cross-market peers outperform domestic text, industry-code, and return-correlation peers in the US-to-Japan setting (ICIR 0.39 versus 0.07--0.18), and cross-market sources beat the domestic text baseline in most target markets. CrossAlpha offers an open-sourced, reusable, return-grounded benchmark for cross-market financial NLP.

AI.tldr: CrossAlpha是一个跨市场因子研究基准数据集，通过披露蒸馏、残差模式图构建和时间对齐评估三个组件，解决跨语言/监管披露标准化、共同报告偏差和跨市场时机对齐三大挑战，覆盖美、日、台、韩、港约3,600家企业，提供约1,900万条有向企业配对评分，验证了跨市场披露同行在收益预测上优于国内替代方案。
AI.motivation: Existing public benchmarks lack support for cross-market disclosure-to-return evaluation, while building such a benchmark faces three key challenges: cross-language/regulatory filing differences, bias from common reporting components in disclosure-derived similarity, and infeasible cross-market timing alignment.
AI.method: Three-component design: (1) Disclosure Distillation standardizes heterogeneous filings into ten-category English business descriptions; (2) Residual Schema Graph Construction builds PCA-whitened cross-market firm-pair scores; (3) Timing-Aligned Evaluation pairs graph with 11 years of daily OHLCV data for forward-return labels under feasible execution protocols.
AI.result: Disclosure-derived cross-market peers outperform domestic text, industry-code, and return-correlation peers in US-to-Japan setting (ICIR 0.39 vs 0.07–0.18), with cross-market sources beating domestic text baseline in most target markets.
AI.conclusion: CrossAlpha provides a reusable, return-grounded open-source benchmark for cross-market financial NLP research, with disclosure-derived cross-market peers significantly outperforming domestic alternatives.

title: Information Security in Small-Scale Protests: Surveillance of Ugandan Anti-EACOP Protesters
comment: To appear at USENIX Security Symposium 2026
summary: We examine the information security practices of Ugandan climate activists protesting the development of the East African Crude Oil Pipeline (EACOP). We conducted five-week fieldwork in Kampala, Uganda, which included interviews with 13 anti-EACOP activists. Through an inductive analysis, we report on the complexities faced by small groups of predominantly student protesters as they covertly organise small-scale anti-EACOP protests within a context marked by state surveillance and repression. Our study points to a multi-layered adversarial landscape, where participants' experiences of direct threats, including arrests and information compromise, and their fears of abduction, shaped their security practices. These practices were rooted in autonomous decision-making within groups. We present a grounded understanding of how participants' need to protect information for their own security, as well as that of others, permeated their lives, leading them to adjust day-to-day aspects of their device management, communication, accommodation, transport and social relations as deliberate tactics to mitigate surveillance.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对13名乌干达反EACOP管道抗议活动人士的访谈，揭示了在国家监控与镇压背景下，气候活动人士如何通过调整日常生活的多个方面来应对信息安全隐患。研究指出参与者面临多层次对抗环境，其安全实践基于团体自主决策，涵盖设备管理、通信、住宿、交通和社交关系等领域。
AI.motivation: 研究关注东非原油管道(EACOP)抗议活动中，乌干兰气候活动人士在国家监控与镇压背景下所面临的信息安全挑战。研究者旨在探索小型学生抗议团体如何在高度对抗的环境中开展隐蔽组织活动。
AI.method: 研究者进行了为期五周的田野调查，地点位于乌干达坎帕拉，期间对13名反EACOP活动人士进行了访谈，并采用归纳分析方法。
AI.result: 研究发现参与者面临着包括逮捕、信息泄露在内的直接威胁，以及对绑架的恐惧，这些经历促使他们采取了多种安全实践。这些实践植根于团体内部的自主决策机制，体现在设备管理、通信、住宿、交通和社交关系的日常调整中。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了抗议者在复杂的多层对抗环境中，通过自主决策来调整设备管理、通信、住宿、交通和社交关系等日常行为，以应对监控威胁。这些发现为理解发展项目中气候抗议者的信息安全实践提供了本土化的理论视角。

title: Design and Implementation of a Serverless MapReduce Framework for Scalable Data Pipelines
summary: Modern logistics systems tend to generate continuous streams of data from sources such as GPS, IoT sensors, and logistics management systems. The aggregation, processing, and analysis of data have become vital for monitoring operations, optimizing efficiency, and responding quickly to decision making tasks. In this paper, an event-driven MapReduce framework for real-time data processing in logistics environments is presented. This system runs on Kubernetes with Knative and utilizes Apache Kafka as the backbone for communication between the components. This platform is composed of five loosely coupled services that receive, process, and aggregate the incoming data in real-time. Redis is used to preserve workflow metadata, while an AWS S3 service provides persistent storage for the framework. The design is inspired by the MapReduce programming model. It integrates Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) principles with distributed processing techniques that allow configurable scaling based on the workload demands and the underlying hardware. Experimental evaluation shows that the system can scale effectively as the input data volume increases while supporting scale-to-zero, on-demand processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个运行在Kubernetes/Knative平台上的事件驱动MapReduce框架，用于物流环境中的实时数据处理。该框架采用五服务松耦合架构，以Apache Kafka为通信骨干，集成FaaS与分布式处理技术，支持可配置扩展。实验结果表明系统具有良好的弹性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现代物流系统通过GPS、物联网传感器和物流管理系统持续产生海量数据流，需要实现数据的聚合、处理和分析，以支持运营监控、效率优化和快速决策响应。
AI.method: 基于MapReduce编程模型设计，整合FaaS原则与分布式处理技术，构建由五个松耦合服务组成的架构，运行于Kubernetes+Knative平台，使用Apache Kafka作为通信骨干，Redis存储工作流元数据，AWS S3提供持久化存储，支持根据工作负载和底层硬件进行可配置扩展。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，系统能够随着输入数据量的增加有效扩展，同时支持零规模扩展和按需处理。
AI.conclusion: 该系统通过将MapReduce编程模型与FaaS架构相结合，在Kubernetes/Knative平台上实现了一个可弹性伸缩的事件驱动框架，能够在数据量增长时保持有效扩展，同时支持零规模扩展和按需处理，为物流环境中的实时数据处理提供了可行的技术方案。

title: CONCAT: Consensus- and Confidence-Driven Ad Hoc Teaming for Efficient LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Although large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems (MAS) show their capability to solve complex tasks and achieve higher performance over single agent systems, they lead to huge computational overheads because of heavy communication between agents. Previous research has made efforts to train a sparse multi-agent graph or fine-tune a planner to orchestrate the workflow better. However, such extra training processes introduce computational costs and limit MAS to specific domains, therefore compromising their generalizability. In this paper, we propose CONCAT, a training-free multi-agent collaboration framework based on CONsensus and Confidence-driven Ad hoc Teaming to efficiently organize agent interactions. Specifically, agents are clustered based on their initial answers, and leaders of each cluster are selected based on the agents' confidence. Then, a heuristic function based on the Theory of Mind is designed to predict the collaboration benefits between every two leaders according to their answers and confidence. Finally, an ad hoc multi-agent network is organized after evicting a percentage of communications based on the predicted benefits. Experiments across three LLMs and three benchmarks show that CONCAT achieves up to 2.02x higher efficiency (accuracy/latency ratio) than LLM-Debate and outperforms training-aware methods such as AgentDropout, while reducing average latency by 50.1% on Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, without any task-specific training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出训练无关（training-free）的多智能体协作框架 CONCAT，通过基于答案聚类、置信度选leader、基于心智理论(ToM)的启发式预测协作收益，并在剔除部分通信后动态组建临时(ad hoc)多智能体网络，在三个LLM与三个基准上比 LLM-Debate 效率最高提升2.02倍、优于需训练的 AgentDropout，在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上平均延迟降低50.1%。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统虽能处理复杂任务、性能优于单智能体，但智能体间密集通信带来巨大计算开销。已有缓解方案（训练稀疏多智能体图、微调planner）需额外训练，带来计算成本并把MAS限制在特定领域，损害泛化性。因此需要一种无需训练、可即插即用地削减通信开销的协作机制。
AI.method: CONCAT = CONsensus and Confidence-driven Ad hoc Teaming，训练无关，三步：1) 基于各智能体的初始答案进行聚类（按答案一致性分组），每簇形成一个候选组；2) 依据智能体自身置信度选出各簇的leader；3) 设计基于心智理论(Theory of Mind)的启发式函数，利用leader的答案与置信度预测任意两个leader之间的协作收益；最后按预测收益对通信边排序，剔除一定比例的通信后组织成ad hoc多智能体网络，使低收益交互不再发生。
AI.result: 在三个LLM与三个基准上的实验表明：CONCAT 的效率（准确率/延迟比）相较 LLM-Debate 最高提升 2.02 倍；优于需训练的 AgentDropout 等training-aware方法；在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上平均延迟降低 50.1%；无需任何任务特定训练。
AI.conclusion: 以"共识+置信度"驱动并辅以心智理论启发式的收益预测，可在不进行任何额外训练的前提下构建临时多智能体协作图，在保持/提升准确率的同时显著削减通信与延迟，证明training-free的动态协作组网能兼顾效率与泛化性，优于依赖训练的稀疏化与planner微调方案。

title: MechELK: A Mechanistic Interpretability Framework for Eliciting Latent Knowledge in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently encode factual and reasoning knowledge in their internal representations that is not faithfully reflected in their surface-level outputs -- a phenomenon known as \emph{latent knowledge}. Existing approaches to eliciting latent knowledge, such as Contrastive Consistency Search (CCS), rely on contrastive activation patterns and struggle with complex multi-step reasoning tasks, while mechanistic interpretability tools have primarily been used to \emph{understand} model behavior rather than to \emph{extract} hidden knowledge. We present \textbf{MechELK}, a unified three-stage framework that bridges mechanistic interpretability and latent knowledge elicitation. MechELK operates through: (1) \textbf{Locate} -- using Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) feature analysis and activation patching to identify knowledge-bearing representations; (2) \textbf{Verify} -- employing causal probing to distinguish genuine latent knowledge from spurious correlations; and (3) \textbf{Elicit} -- applying representation engineering to surface hidden knowledge without modifying model weights. Evaluated on TruthfulQA, a curated Deceptive Alignment benchmark, and the Quirky LM dataset, MechELK achieves an average elicitation accuracy of 84.7\%, outperforming CCS by 6.2\% and direct linear probing by 9.1\%. Crucially, MechELK successfully identifies latent knowledge in 78.3\% of cases where the model's surface output is incorrect or evasive, demonstrating its utility for AI safety applications including deceptive alignment detection.

AI.tldr: MechELK是一个统一的三阶段框架，通过结合稀疏自编码器特征分析、激活修补、因果探针和表征工程，将机制可解释性与潜在知识抽取相桥接。在TruthfulQA等数据集上达到84.7%的平均抽取准确率，显著优于现有方法，并能有效识别模型表面输出错误或回避情况下的隐藏知识，为AI安全应用提供重要工具。
AI.motivation: Large language models encode factual and reasoning knowledge internally that is not reflected in their outputs (latent knowledge). Existing approaches like Contrastive Consistency Search (CCS) rely on contrastive activation patterns and struggle with complex multi-step reasoning tasks. Meanwhile, mechanistic interpretability tools have primarily been used to understand rather than extract hidden knowledge.
AI.method: MechELK proposes a three-stage framework: (1) Locate - using Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) feature analysis and activation patching to identify knowledge-bearing representations; (2) Verify - employing causal probing to distinguish genuine latent knowledge from spurious correlations; (3) Elicit - applying representation engineering to surface hidden knowledge without modifying model weights.
AI.result: On TruthfulQA, Deceptive Alignment benchmark, and Quirky LM dataset, MechELK achieves 84.7% average elicitation accuracy (6.2% improvement over CCS, 9.1% over direct linear probing). Critically, it successfully identifies latent knowledge in 78.3% of cases where the model's surface output is incorrect or evasive.
AI.conclusion: MechELK provides a unified bridge between mechanistic interpretability and latent knowledge elicitation, demonstrating practical utility for AI safety applications including deceptive alignment detection by successfully surfacing hidden knowledge in cases where models give incorrect or evasive responses.

title: Molecular Lead Optimization via Agentic Tool Planning
summary: Drug discovery is a lengthy and resource-intensive process composed of multiple stages. Among these stages, lead optimization plays a critical role in transforming early hit compounds into viable drug candidates. This stage requires improving ADMET-related properties through subtle structural refinement while preserving key molecular substructures responsible for binding affinity to disease targets. Recent advances in artificial intelligence have shown promise in accelerating various aspects of drug discovery; however, most existing approaches to lead optimization rely on one-step molecular optimization, which fail to account for the long-term consequences of sequential design decisions. To address this limitation, we propose TRACE, a trajectory-aware, LLM-reasoning agent for molecular lead optimization that formulates tool selection as a sequential decision-making problem over action trajectories. Given a lead molecule and an optimization objective, TRACE makes trajectory-aware decisions over molecular optimization tools, enabling forward-looking refinement under structural constraints. Experiments on multiple ADMET optimization tasks show that our agent achieves higher optimization success, larger property improvements, and higher validity, while preserving molecular similarity compared to baseline models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TRACE，一个轨迹感知的LLM推理智能体，用于分子先导化合物优化。该方法通过将工具选择建模为顺序决策问题，克服了现有单步优化方法的局限性，在ADMET优化任务上取得了优于基线模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI辅助先导化合物优化方法主要采用单步优化策略，无法考虑顺序设计决策的长期影响。这一局限性导致优化过程缺乏全局视角，可能在多步优化中走向次优甚至无效的分子结构。
AI.method: 提出了TRACE框架，一个基于大语言模型(LLM)的推理智能体。该框架将分子优化工具的选择建模为沿着动作轨迹的顺序决策问题，使智能体能够在保持结构约束的前提下进行前瞻性的分子优化。
AI.result: TRACE在多个ADMET优化任务中表现出更高的优化成功率、更大的属性改善幅度、更好的分子有效性和相似性保留。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过将工具选择建模为顺序决策问题，实现了前瞻性的分子优化。实验表明该方法在ADMET优化任务上优于基线模型，证明了轨迹感知推理在药物发现中的有效性。

title: Ultra-Reduced-Impact-Encased-Logging (URIEL): propose a new method for selective sustainable logging and post-harvest silvicultural treatment in tropical forest using airborne robotics systems
comment: 196 pages, 40 figures, A revolutionary technology to help protect tropical forests. It was developed, scaled, detailed, calculated, and simulated in an advanced computational environment, com viabilidade econômica e social. "E pur si muove"
summary: Tropical forests worldwide are under intense deforestation pressure driven by economic and political interests, and scientific evidence suggests this deforestation contributes to climate change. This paper proposes a novel logging method for tropical forests, Ultra-Reduced-Impact-Encased-Logging (URIEL). This new method is based on heli-logging techniques combined with intensive use of robotics and AI integrated with post-harvest silvicultural treatments performed by drones. The concept of appropriate equipment for this method was developed, dimensions were determined, details were completed in a digital proof of concept, and an effective digital simulation and economic feasibility analysis were carried out for various helicopter-timber-distance combinations. The results demonstrated that a URIEL method has high economic viability and makes it possible to virtually eliminate collateral damage to forests while maintaining ecosystem services. The main conclusion of this paper is that, despite the satisfactory scientific and technological results, the feasibility of a Uriel method depends on the integration of stakeholders intrinsic to the context: high-tech industry; political governments; certified logging companies; and native populations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"超低影响封装采伐"(URIEL)新方法：以直升机集运(heli-logging)技术为基础，深度集成机器人、人工智能与无人机飞播造林等采后营林措施，并通过数字概念验证、仿真模拟与经济可行性分析（针对不同"直升机—木材"距离组合）评估。结果显示该方法经济可行性高，且能在维持生态系统服务的同时近乎消除采伐对森林的附带损害；但其实际落地取决于高科技产业、政府、认证采伐企业与原住民等利益相关方的协同整合。
AI.motivation: 全球热带森林正承受由经济与政治利益驱动的剧烈砍伐压力，而科学证据表明砍伐是气候变化的重要贡献者。传统采伐（地面拖集、砍伐木集运）会造成大量附带损害：林下植被与土壤压实、河流污染、生物多样性下降、碳储量损失，且木材损失率高。亟需一种能够显著降低环境影响、同时保持经济可行性与木材产量的新型采伐技术，以应对热带森林可持续经营与减少毁林（deforestation）排放的现实需求。
AI.method: 提出URIEL（Ultra-Reduced-Impact-Encased-Logging，超低影响封装采伐）作业体系：核心是以直升机为集运平台（heli-logging）进行"封装"式采运，减少对地面的直接扰动与拖曳；在此基础上引入机器人系统承担伐木、造材与集运等高强度环节，利用人工智能进行木材识别、路径规划与作业优化，并结合无人机执行的采后营林处理（飞播、抚育、监测）实现快速林分恢复。方法流程包括：①依据作业需求确定配套设备概念并完成尺寸与参数设计；②构建数字概念验证（digital proof of concept）模型；③建立有效的数字仿真模型；④针对不同直升机运距（直升机—木材距离）组合开展经济可行性分析，测算不同配置下的单位木材成本与收益；⑤从生态（附带损害最小化、碳与生态系统服务保持）与经济（回报、可行性）双维度综合评估方案。
AI.result: 研究结果表明：URIEL方法具有较高的经济可行性，在多种直升机—木材距离组合下均能维持可行的成本—收益结构；通过"封装"式直升机集运与机器人、AI的高精度作业，可近乎消除传统采伐造成的附带损害（collateral damage），同时保持生态系统服务功能；数字仿真与概念验证证明该技术体系在工程与操作层面可实现；配套的无人机采后营林措施为林地即时恢复提供了技术保障。
AI.conclusion: 尽管科学与技术层面的结果令人满意，URIEL方法的实际可行性本质上取决于特定情境下多方利益相关者的整合：高科技产业（设备与AI供应）、政治/政府（政策、许可与监管框架）、经认证的合法采伐企业（实施与合规）以及原住民群体（土地权利、社区共管与社会认同）。因此该方法并非单纯的工程方案，而是"技术—制度—社会"协同的系统性路径；其推广需在推动低碳、可持续热带森林经营与缓解毁林相关气候变化的背景下，以多方治理为落地前提。

title: TC-MIS: Maximal Independent Set on Tensor-cores
summary: Maximal Independent Set (MIS) in a graph is a fundamental problem with applications in resource allocation, scheduling, and network optimization. Although graphs are inherently un-structured and challenging for GPU parallelism due to irregular memory access and workload imbalance, specialized GPU algorithms have achieved good performance, processing million-vertex graphs in milliseconds. Modern GPUs are equipped with Tensor Cores (TCs), specialized units for matrix operations with 8-16x higher throughput than CUDA Cores (CCs), which are extensively used for ML, DL, and inference tasks but remain largely unexplored for graph algorithms. In this paper, we present TC-MIS, a TC-accelerated algorithm that reformulates key phases of MIS computation as sparse matrix-vector multiplication (SpMV). TC-MIS tiles the graph adjacency matrix and employs Warp Matrix Multiply-Accumulate (WMMA) operations to transform irregular graph traversal into regular, massively parallel computation. Our evaluation across TC-enabled microarchitectures (Ampere, Ada Lovelace, Hopper, Blackwell) demonstrates that TC-MIS achieves an average speedup of 2.84x on RTX A5000, 4.84x on L40S, 18.80x on H200 GPUs, and 5.20x on RTX 5080 with a maximum speedup of 44.38x on H200 GPU over state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining solution quality comparable to that obtained by established heuristics that produce near-maximum independent sets.

AI.tldr: TC-MIS 首次将图的最大独立集（MIS）计算重构为张量核心（TC）上基于 WMMA 的分块稀疏矩阵-向量乘（SpMV），把不规则的邻接表遍历转为规则的大规模并行矩阵运算。在 Ampere/Ada/Hopper/Blackwell 四代 GPU 上相比 SOTA 的 ECL-MIS 取得 2.84×–18.80× 平均加速（H200 上最高 44.38×），同时通过“度数感知优先级 + 冲突消解”启发式（H3）保持与 ECL-MIS 几乎相同的 MIS 基数（平均偏差仅 0.17%）。
AI.motivation: GPU 上的图算法（尤其是 MIS）受制于不规则访存、度分布倾斜、负载不均与 warp 分歧，现有 SOTA 方法 ECL-MIS 全程依赖 CUDA Core（CC）。作者剖析 ECL-MIS 发现其“候选选择与邻居消除”阶段（Phase 2）平均占运行时间的 56.4%，是主要瓶颈。现代 GPU 的 Tensor Core 对矩阵运算吞吐是 CC 的 8–16 倍，但 CSR 邻接矩阵无法自然分解为 WMMA 所需的 16×16 固定分块，故 TC 在 MIS 这类不规则图算法上几乎未被探索。核心研究问题是：能否重新设计并行 MIS 算法以利用 TC 的巨大吞吐？以及 TC 能否用于稠密线性代数之外的不规则通用图计算？
AI.method: 提出 TC-MIS，采用异构三阶段流水线（Algorithm 2）：Phase 1（CC）：用优先级启发式计算邻居优先级最大值 Max_Np，生成候选向量 C；Phase 2（TC 核心）：将邻接矩阵表示为 16×16 分块的压缩块稀疏格式（A 为 half 类型非零块，C 打包为分块布局），执行 N_c = A × C 的 SpMV，每个非零块映射到一个 CUDA 线程块、由单个 warp 通过 WMMA 的 load_matrix_sync/mma_sync 完成并以 FP32 累加，仅做 N_c(v)>0 的谓词判断；候选段全零的块直接跳过（早期退出），原子操作仅在块粒度而非边粒度使用；Phase 3（CC，无锁）：各线程仅依据本地 C(v) 与 N_c(v) 独立更新自身状态，实现隐式邻居消除，候选与邻居同时失活。实现上使用持久化/多波次调度以处理远超驻留 warp 数的块数量，空间换计算规则性。三种优先级启发式：H1 随机（hash）、H2 度数感知（复现 ECL-MIS 公式）、H3 度数感知+有序冲突消解（Alive set → 冲突消解 → 候选定稿 → 状态更新，避免 tile 内优先级反转导致的过早消除）。基线为 ECL-MIS，数据集取自 SuiteSparse（0.26M–4.85M 顶点，2.35M–182M 边），测试 RTX A5000、L40S、H200、RTX 5080。
AI.result: 解质量（H200 上对比 ECL-MIS 的 H2）：H1 平均偏差 10.43%，H2 降至 2.42%，H3 仅 0.17%（在 G5、G7 上零偏差），说明 H3 兼顾质量与并行效率。性能：RTX A5000 平均 2.84×，L40S 4.84×，H200 18.80×，RTX 5080 5.16×（摘要中给出 5.20×），最高 44.38×（H200 上的 G3）。加速比随 GPU 代际单调上升（L40S→H200 达 3.88× 乘性增益），源于 TC 与 CC 吞吐比扩大。加速比与图结构强相关：稀疏规则图 G3 最优；度分布高度倾斜的 G4 最低（1.14×–5.23×）；稠密图 G6/G8 中等（16.26×/18.40×）。Phase 2 时间占比：TC-MIS 为 6.3%–26.2%，ECL-MIS 为 25.9%–66.7%；例如 5080 上 G1 的 Phase 2 占比 6.3%（相对 ECL-MIS 的 46.8% 降低 7.43×），H200 上 G3 为 11.9%（相对 29.5% 改善 2.48×），此时 TC-MIS 的 Phase 1 占 83.1%，说明剩余瓶颈已转移到 CC 侧。
AI.conclusion: 将 MIS 的核心邻域交互重写为分块 WMMA-SpMV，可在不规则图工作负载上有效利用 Tensor Core，性能随 TC 吞吐扩展，提供超越传统 CC GPU 内核的显著收益，且通过 H3 保持近最大独立集的质量。主要局限：分块邻接矩阵带来额外内存占用，尚未支持十亿级图；Phase 1（不规则的优先级与邻居最大值计算）现已成为主要瓶颈。作者未来工作：设计 CC/TC 共享的数据结构以降低内存开销、加载十亿规模图；扩展到频繁插入/删除边的动态图场景。

title: The Missing Dimensions in Geo-Distributed Database Evaluation
summary: Geo-distributed OLTP databases are widely deployed across cloud regions, yet current evaluation practices do not cover the challenges of this aspect. Existing benchmarks assume stable network conditions; they lack explicit settings for data and client locality, and they largely ignore data transfer costs across regions. In addition, most evaluations rely on a limited set of geo-distribution patterns. In this paper, we propose Gaia, a comprehensive evaluation framework that addresses these gaps. We use Gaia to perform a comprehensive evaluation of existing geo-distributed OLTP systems. We deploy them across multiple cloud regions, using different geo-distribution patterns and variable cross-region network conditions. Among other interesting findings, our framework reveals that: i) most systems are sensitive to network instabilities, ii) network costs dominate cloud deployment expenses iii) multi-region fault-tolerance mechanisms incur measurable critical-path overhead that is often overlooked in prior evaluations. We argue that for the design of future geo-distributed databases, we must rethink the trade-offs between performance, fault-tolerance, and cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了面向地域分布式（geo-distributed）OLTP 数据库的评测框架 Gaia，补齐现有基准缺失的维度：跨区域数据迁移成本与货币化成本、网络延迟/抖动/丢包等不稳定条件、客户端与数据局部性（LSH/FSH/MH 访问模式）、以及节点/区域级故障容错。用 Gaia 在 AWS 4 个区域（8 个区域配置）上评测了 Calvin、SLOG、Detock、Janus 与 CockroachDB（CRDB）五个系统，得出三大结论：多数系统对网络不稳定高度敏感；跨区域网络传输费用主导云端部署开销；多区域容错机制在关键路径上带来可观开销（常被既有评测忽略）。作者主张未来地域分布式数据库设计必须重新权衡性能、容错与成本。
AI.motivation:
当前地域分布式 OLTP 数据库（如 Spanner、Aurora、CockroachDB）已广泛部署，但现有评测实践存在系统性缺口：
1. 传统基准（TPC-C、YCSB、SmallBank）均设计于单区域场景十余年前，其 schema 与数据分布难以刻画真实的地域访问模式；对 TPC-C 默认配置实测（200 万笔事务）显示 95.36% 为 LSH、4.21% 为 MH、仅 0.44% 为 FSH，与真实全球零售负载严重脱节（纯 FSH NewOrder 概率低至 2.48×10⁻²⁸）。
2. 几乎所有评测假设理想稳定网络，缺少对网络延迟、抖动、丢包的建模（实测超过 2/3 的互联网路径延迟 >100ms，AWS 最慢连接 p50 可达 600ms）。
3. 数据迁移（跨区域 egress）体积与费用几乎完全被忽略，Table I 显示 16 个相关系统中无一同时覆盖数据迁移与货币成本。
4. 只用单一类型云 VM、场景狭窄、未考虑 FSH 事务、未充分研究异构网络条件。
5. 数据分区归属与客户端提交位置不对称（FSH）在文献中被忽视，而 Detock 等系统的 home-movement 机制正是为解决该问题设计。
AI.method:
Gaia 框架设计：
- 事务访问模式分类法：按访问分区数（SP/MP）与涉及区域数划分，并按客户端发起的 origin 区域与主副本 home 区域是否一致，精化为 LSH（本地单主）、FSH（异地单主，至少一次跨区往返）、MH（多主，需跨区协调）；协调基于主副本而非副本定位，home 默认按分区随机均匀分配。
- 部署类场景：可扩展输入吞吐（寻找 p99 延迟爆炸前的饱和点）、资源分配（5 种 EC2 实例类型：m5.2xlarge/4xlarge、r5.2xlarge/4xlarge、m6i.8xlarge）、服务器地域分布（uniform、usw+、usw++、usw++ eu++ 等 5 种偏斜配置）。
- 基准类场景：访问模式比例可调（YCSB 直接支持 LSH/FSH/MH 百分比；TPC-C 通过调整 NewOrder/Payment 远程仓库概率，地域比例 0–88%）、访问偏斜（选用 Zipfian 系数 θ∈[0,1]，相较 HOT 记录集方案无需预知最大热集规模）。
- 韧性场景：网络延迟与抖动（0–600ms + 10% 抖动，用 NetEm 注入）、丢包（0–10% 随机丢弃）、故障容错（单节点失效与整区域失效两条故障轨迹）。
- 指标：吞吐、按 LSH/FSH/MH 分类的延迟、abort 率、跨区域数据迁移量（用改进版 iftop 抓包统计 egress，因云厂商按 egress 计费）、每事务成本 C=(n_s·c_s + n_b·c_b + n_d·c_d)/t（VM 租赁 + 跨区传输 + 持久存储）、资源利用率（CPU/RAM/网络/磁盘 I/O）。
- 实验方法：AWS r5.4xlarge（16 vCPU/128GB），每区域 4 个数据库服务器 + 1 个客户端 VM，4 大区域 8 节点；先测各区域对 RTT 基线，再将 VM 集中到单区域用 NetEm 注入损伤；采用消融式（ablation）方法而非全网格搜索；Calvin/Janus 全复制，SLOG/Detock 主区域存储，CRDB 多区域同步复制（单独 y 轴）；YCSB 默认 LSH:FSH:MH=50:25:25、MP=50%；TPC-C 1200 仓库、1% 远程订单/支付概率。
AI.result:
1) 吞吐与饱和：SLOG、Detock 的 YCSB 输入吞吐可达约 100k 后 p99 才超过 10s；Calvin、Janus 更早饱和；TPC-C 下内存压力成瓶颈。CRDB 峰值吞吐低（YCSB 4k、TPC-C 500 txns/s，与文献 tpmC 量级一致），但具备生产级容错。
2) 成本结构：数据迁移费用占绝对主导（VM+存储固定成本约 1¢/事务且随吞吐摊薄）；YCSB 稳定后每事务总成本从 1.5¢/10k txns（Janus、Calvin）到 2.5¢/10k txns（SLOG、Detock、CRDB）；SLOG/Detock 数据迁移量近 Calvin/Janus 两倍；TPC-C 下前四者成本收敛约 1.6¢/10k txns，CRDB 约 20¢/10k txns。
3) 硬件：更强机型虽然单价更高，却通过提升吞吐摊薄固定成本并缩短关键路径，从而降低每事务成本；对多数系统数据传输费用而非计算/存储是主要瓶颈（CRDB 相反，计算占比更大）。
4) 服务器地域偏斜：对吞吐/延迟/数据迁移影响可忽略（访问模式未变），但成本最多降低 2 倍（偏斜部署把跨区通信变为区内免费通信）。
5) 访问模式：SLOG/Detock 吞吐随地域比例上升稳步下降（CPU 利用率下降约 40%），p50 延迟显著上升；FSH 延迟从 20ms 增至 250ms；Calvin、Janus、CRDB 对三类事务一视同仁、曲线稳定但绝对延迟高；Janus 与 Calvin 在高地域比例下更具成本优势；Calvin/Janus 不区分读写与 LSH/FSH/MH，SLOG/Detock 在读与 LSH 上快一个数量级。
6) 网络延迟与抖动：Janus 最鲁棒（0→111ms 几乎无影响，之后线性劣化），源于无冲突事务单往返提交；SLOG/Detock 在 TPC-C 下约 150ms 即达拐点，吞吐损失 90%、延迟增至 10 倍；高延迟下每事务成本普遍爆炸；CRDB 在单区域（0ms）部署时 YCSB 吞吐可翻倍。
7) 丢包：仅 2% 丢包即导致 Calvin/SLOG/Detock 吞吐下降 35–60% 并延迟恶化；CRDB 最具韧性，Janus 次之；极端丢包时延迟与成本爆炸。
8) 故障容错：五个系统中仅 CRDB 能承受单节点与整区域失效并自动恢复，无数据丢失；单节点失效（32 节点中 1 个）吞吐降约 40%，恢复后约 10s 回到稳态；区域失效时约 15s 后其他区域客户端仍可访问未受影响数据，随后全集群阻塞。
AI.conclusion: 仅看性能的评测不足以反映地域分布式数据库的真实面貌：网络不稳定性、跨区域数据传输与容错机制共同决定性能与经济可行性。论文主张未来的评测必须显式纳入四类维度：LSH/FSH/MH 工作负载组成；跨区数据传输量与货币成本；网络延迟、抖动与丢包；节点级与区域级故障容错。作者呼吁社区把"成本感知、网络感知、故障感知的基准评测"作为地域分布式数据库研究的标准实践。系统设计层面：协议设计决定鲁棒性（协调轮次少的协议更稳健，Janus 最优）；容错机制在关键路径上的开销需被正视（脱离容错的孤立评测会高估新协议）；高 WAN 延迟常使 RAM/磁盘闲置而通信费用主导账单，需在性能与成本间寻求平衡协议；多参数（吞吐/延迟/成本/可用性）优化与 Pareto 前沿是架构师的现实难题；此外还需要深入研究 TPC-C/YCSB/SmallBank/MovR/PPS 等基准遗漏的事务特征，构建可配置、贴近云厂商真实负载的新型基准。

title: SCDBench: A Benchmark for LLM-Based Smart Contract Decompilers
summary: Smart contract decompilation aims to recover high-level source code from bytecode, but evaluating decompilers remains difficult because existing studies use narrow datasets, inconsistent metrics, and limited semantic consistency checks. This gap is increasingly important as large language models (LLMs) begin to generate source-like Solidity that may compile and appear plausible, even when its semantics diverge from the original contract. We introduce SCDBench, a dataset and benchmark methodology for LLM-based smart contract decompilation. The dataset contains 600 real-world Solidity contracts with paired bytecode inputs, ground-truth source code, and replayable semantic checkpoints. SCDBench evaluates decompiler outputs through four cumulative stages: format completeness, compilability, Application Binary Interface (ABI) recovery, and semantic consistency via differential replay. We evaluate Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.3-Codex, and GLM-5 in a zero-shot decompilation setting, including GLM-5 variants with and without extended reasoning and a zero-shot compilation-repair setting. The results show that frontier LLMs can often produce structured and compilable Solidity, but achieving semantic consistency remains far from solved: the best-performing frontier model perfectly decompiles only 42/600 contracts. We further show that introducing same-model compilation repair substantially improves performance at modest additional cost. SCDBench establishes a common ground for rigorous, reproducible evaluation and aims to accelerate the development of reliable smart contract decompilers for blockchain security and transparency.

AI.tldr: SCDBench是用于评估LLM智能合约反编译能力的标准化基准，包含600个真实合约和四阶段评估体系。研究表明当前前沿模型虽能生成可编译代码，但语义一致性仍是未解决的难题。
AI.motivation: 现有反编译评估存在数据集窄、指标不一致、语义一致性检查不足等问题；LLM生成的可能编译通过但语义偏离的Solidity代码增加了评估难度
AI.method: 600个真实Solidity合约数据集；四阶段累积评估（格式完整性→可编译性→ABI恢复→语义一致性差分重放）；零样本设置评估Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.3-Codex、GLM-5及其变体；包含同模型编译修复实验
AI.result: 前沿LLM能生成结构化可编译的Solidity代码，但语义一致性远未解决；最佳模型仅42/600合约达到完全反编译；同模型编译修复可显著提升性能
AI.conclusion: SCDBench为智能合约反编译提供标准化评估框架；前沿LLM在格式和编译方面表现较好，但语义一致性仍未解决（最佳模型仅42/600完全正确）；同模型编译修复可显著提升性能；该基准旨在推动可靠智能合约反编译器的发展

title: UniNote: A Unified Embedding Model for Multimodal Representation and Ranking
summary: Item-to-Item (I2I) retrieval is a fundamental part of modern content platforms, supporting critical industrial workflows from recommendation engines to content auditing. While multimodal embedding methods have advanced general retrieval, they often falter in I2I scenarios due to the challenges of balancing global content representation with fine-grained local retrieval, the systemic inefficiency of decoupled embedding-and-ranking pipelines, and the inherent trade-offs between model precision and serving latency. To solve these issues, we propose \textbf{UniNote}, a unified embedding model designed for industrial I2I retrieval. Tailored retrieval strategies are introduced to support representation learning over complex, multimodal content at varying granularities. To operationalize these strategies, UniNote employs a two-stage training paradigm: the first stage leverages contrastive SFT to establish robust base embeddings, while the second stage refines ranking quality through a reinforcement learning (RL) process that aligns the model with content relevance. Our results show that UniNote achieves SOTA performance across diverse I2I tasks. Deployed at Xiaohongshu and integrated with Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL), UniNote achieved significant improvements in retrieval quality and cost efficiency in large-scale applications.

AI.tldr: UniNote是专为工业级I2I检索设计的统一嵌入模型，通过两阶段训练（对比SFT+RL排序优化）解决多模态检索中的粒度平衡、流水线效率和精度延迟权衡等挑战，在小红书大规模应用中验证了卓越的检索质量和成本效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 multimodal嵌入方法在I2I检索场景中面临三大核心挑战：①全局内容表征与细粒度局部检索的平衡难题；②嵌入与排序两阶段解耦带来的系统性低效；③模型精度与服务延迟之间的固有权衡。
AI.method: ①设计适配复杂多模态内容不同粒度的定制化检索策略；②采用两阶段训练范式：第一阶段通过对比学习SFT建立鲁棒基础嵌入，第二阶段通过强化学习(RL)过程优化排序质量，实现与内容相关性的对齐；③集成Matryoshka表示学习(MRL)以提升效率。
AI.result: 在多种I2I任务上达到SOTA性能；大规模工业部署验证了检索质量和成本效率的显著提升。
AI.conclusion: UniNote achieves SOTA performance across diverse I2I tasks; deployed at Xiaohongshu with MRL integration, it delivers significant improvements in both retrieval quality and cost efficiency for large-scale industrial applications.

title: When Should AI Read the Room? Public Perceptions of Social Intelligence in AI Agents
summary: AI researchers have been advancing socially intelligent AI agents (Social-AI) across embodiments, from chatbots to physical robots. As Social-AI is increasingly deployed in everyday settings, decisions about the roles these agents should play will depend on how laypeople perceive them. However, public perceptions of social intelligence in AI agents and the acceptability of these agents remain largely understudied. We present a mixed-methods survey of adults in the United States (N=200) that examines social intelligence as a perceived construct in AI agents. Our survey investigates the extent to which participants believe current AI agents have social intelligence, abilities of agents that participants associate with social intelligence, contextual factors influencing participant acceptance of Social-AI agents, and concerns participants hold about these technologies. Participants widely reported having already encountered AI agents they perceived as socially intelligent and grounded their judgments in observable behaviors, more than beliefs about AI agency or intent. We identified a support-adoption gap in acceptability judgments: participants supported the existence of Social-AI agents for others far more than for their own personal use. Our analysis uncovers layperson concerns about Social-AI, informing AI governance regarding appropriate deployment contexts, agent roles, and risks to end users.

AI.tldr: 本文通过针对美国成年人的混合方法调查（N=200），首次实证研究公众如何看待AI智能体的"社会智能"，发现公众判断主要基于可观察行为而非AI的能动性或意图假设，且存在显著的"支持-采纳落差"——参与者远比愿意自己使用更支持这类智能体的存在。研究为Social-AI的部署、角色设定、风险治理提供了以用户为中心的依据。
AI.motivation: Social-AI（具备社会智能的AI智能体）正从实验室进入家庭、医院、教育、酒店等日常场景，其部署位置、方式与面向人群的决策不应仅由少数研究者依据技术能力决定，还需考虑普通人如何感知这些智能体。已有HCI研究虽说明人类会把计算机当作社会行动者、并形成整体印象与拟人化倾向，但并未直接回答"用户是否认为AI具备社会智能"、"哪些行为让用户认为其具备社会智能"。同时，"读懂场合"（read the room）能力涉及敏感交互数据的采集，带来信息获取与隐私隐患。因此本文从参与式AI与以人为中心的视角出发，测量公众对社会智能的感知、接受度与顾虑。
AI.method: 混合方法调查（mixed-methods survey），样本为200名美国成年人，通过Prolific招募。围绕四个研究问题展开：RQ1 公众认为当前AI智能体在多大程度上具备社会智能；RQ2 智能体展现哪些能力会说服公众其具备社会智能；RQ3 部署情境与智能体本体（聊天机器人 vs. 自主机器人 vs. 遥操作机器人）对接受度的影响；RQ4 公众对社会智能AI的风险与顾虑。测量工具包括：感知AI社会智能量表（1道整体题+7道能力题的Likert计分）、AI素养量表（7项）、以及12种可接受性情境（4种情境：居家跌倒告警、医院导览、医院情绪困扰告警、居家工作支持 × 3种智能体类型），每个情境下分别对"为自己主动寻求""为自己主动回避""为他人存在而高兴"三项评分（归一化到0–1）。数据分析使用Spearman相关（BH校正的FDR）、线性回归（HC3稳健标准误）、三个线性混合效应模型（固定效应为情境、智能体类型及交互，参与者为随机截距，Wald检验）、Wilcoxon符号秩检验（Holm校正，检验支持-采纳落差），以及针对数据采集/存储选择情境的McNemar精确检验；开放式回答经人工编码归类（RQ2能力编码、RQ4顾虑编码）。
AI.result: （1）公众普遍已将社会智能归因于AI智能体，其判断主要基于可观察行为（识别并恰当回应人类情绪、令人愉悦健谈、感觉自然类人、建立融洽与信任、主动提供有用帮助、辨识对错伦理），而非认为系统具有内在能动性或意图（"有目的并遵循自身意图"得分最低，M=2.94；"具备社会智能"整体题M=3.57）。七个能力项与整体社会智能题均显著相关（ρ=0.367–0.636，FDR校正后p<.001）。（2）发现"支持-采纳落差"：12个条件下"为他人存在而高兴"的评分均显著高于"为自己主动寻求"，条件差距0.14–0.23，总体均值0.20（Wilcoxon检验p<.001，Holm校正）。（3）接受度随情境变化：居家跌倒告警最受欢迎（寻求M=0.63–0.71，高兴M=0.75–0.86），居家工作支持最低（寻求0.43–0.53）；智能体本体呈现聊天机器人 > 自主机器人 > 遥操作机器人的趋势（混合模型中智能体类型主效应均p<.001），且对回避与"为他人高兴"的评价存在情境×类型交互（p=.016、p=.020）。（4）AI素养与接受度正相关（寻求ρ=0.369，高兴ρ=0.388，回避ρ=−0.293），感知社会智能程度亦正相关（ρ=0.367–0.404），控制聊天机器人/机器人使用频率后关联仍显著。（5）数据采集偏好：参与者普遍倾向"仅在交互时"采集而非持续感知（如自主/本地条件语音仅主动采集120人 vs 仅持续13人），并更接受本地存储而非云端存储；8项McNemar比较Holm校正后均p<.001。（6）定性编码显示顾虑集中于隐私、数据滥用、操纵、过度依赖、错误响应/情境误读、削弱人际连接与人的自我照护能力、治理与问责缺失、高估功能与社交能力，以及对具身机器人在私人空间的不适感。
AI.conclusion: 社会智能不仅是研究者设想的技术目标，已经是普通人看待其所遇AI智能体的既有认知框架。公众承认Social-AI的潜在收益，但同时在隐私、数据滥用、社会与心理危害等维度存在明显保留；其接受度高度依赖具体情境与智能体本体，且"支持他人使用"显著高于"自己采纳"，说明部署决策不能以技术能力单一依据，必须纳入公众偏好与风险感知。实践建议包括：默认"仅交互时感知"、本地化存储交互数据、在私人空间谨慎使用具身/遥操作机器人、避免夸大智能体的情感与功能能力、并在部署前建立问责与防护机制。研究以N=200的样本量与美国受众为限，未来可扩展到更多文化背景与更长期的实地部署研究。

title: Evolve as a Team: Collaborative Self-Evolution for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as an effective paradigm for complex and long-horizon tasks. However, in real-world tasks, MAS often exhibit various failures during execution and such failures are difficult to eliminate during design. This motivates experience-driven MAS evolution, where a system improves based on its own execution experience. Yet such evolution is challenging because MAS experience is prolonged and intricate, interleaving multiple agents' execution chains and communication messages, which makes it difficult to identify what should be improved. To address this challenge, we propose Meta-Team, an experience-driven MAS evolution framework based on collaborative self-evolution. Meta-Team preserves the execution context of each agent and coordinates post-task communication, enabling agents to exchange distributed evidence for evolution. Building on this design, Meta-Team conducts multi-scale self-evolution, transforming execution experience into reusable improvements to agent behaviors, inter-agent coordination, and team-level organization. Across six long-horizon agent benchmarks, Meta-Team consistently outperforms single-agent systems, hand-crafted MAS, and prior MAS evolution methods; further analyses demonstrate that Meta-Team enables more reliable and scalable MAS self-evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Meta-Team框架，通过保留执行上下文、协调Agent间通信，实现多尺度自我进化（行为、协作、组织层面），将复杂的多Agent执行经验转化为可复用的改进。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的多Agent系统（MAS）虽在复杂长视野任务中表现有效，但在执行过程中常出现各种故障，且这些故障在设计阶段难以消除，因此需要系统能够基于自身执行经验进行改进。
AI.method: Meta-Team通过保留每个Agent的执行上下文、协调任务后通信，使Agent能够交换分布式证据用于进化；并在此基础上进行多尺度自我进化，将执行经验转化为Agent行为、Agent间协作和团队级组织三个层面的可复用改进。
AI.result: 实验表明Meta-Team在六个长视野Agent基准测试中一致优于单Agent系统、手工设计的MAS和先前的MAS进化方法。
AI.conclusion: Meta-Team在六个长视野Agent基准测试中持续优于单Agent系统、手工设计的MAS及先前的MAS进化方法，验证了其能够实现更可靠且可扩展的MAS自我进化。

title: From Context Shift to Stylistic Collapse: Why Training Objectives Matter More Than Scale
comment: 26 pages, 13 tables, 2 figures. Planning to submit to NeurIPS 2026
summary: In modern LLMs, linguistic features function not as stylistic artifacts but as probes of probability mass, allocated under training alignment objectives. Language models trained with contemporary pipelines exhibit severe reshaping of linguistic features, leading to extreme language re-distribution. While previous stylometric analyses explored linguistic differences between AI-generated and human texts, we focus on the reshaping plaguing the LLM training pipeline itself. We analyze 17 models (410M-100B+ parameters) across 24 linguistically-motivated probes, documenting that instruction-tuned systems systematically collapse language entropy along discourse and structural dimensions (mean amplification: 1,949-16,853%, peaks: 5,181-209,675%), while selectively suppressing complex punctuation to 3.2-23.2% of baseline frequencies. These effects do not worsen under RLHF, as divergence patterns are statistically indistinguishable (p > 0.25) across matched base and instruction-tuned model pairs. Weak intervention (lambda=1.0) exacerbates collapse by 240%, while strong control (lambda=5.0) achieves 40.5% improvement and outperforms frontier models by 96.7-98.2% despite 200-1000x scale disadvantage. Additionally, lambda=5.0 delivers 15% higher distinct-4, 27% higher vocabulary diversity, and 78% lower repetition than moderate regularization, establishing that alignment requires sufficient control strength, not merely distributional smoothing. Our findings underscore how modern LLMs reallocate stylistic probability mass, despite RLHF and scale. More broadly, our work reveals a structural limitation of current alignment pipelines: preference optimization reshapes language distributions invisible to standard quality metrics yet detectable through distributional probes, with implications for AI detection, training data contamination, and long-term linguistic evolution.

AI.tldr: This paper reveals that instruction-tuned LLMs systematically collapse language diversity and suppress complex punctuation regardless of model scale or RLHF application. Strong controllable decoding (lambda=5.0) effectively counteracts these alignment-induced distortions, suggesting that alignment requires sufficient control strength rather than mere distributional smoothing.
AI.motivation: The motivation stems from the observation that modern LLM training pipelines severely reshape linguistic features, leading to extreme language re-distribution. While prior stylometric research focused on differences between AI-generated and human texts, this work aims to understand how the training process itself reshapes linguistic characteristics within the LLM development pipeline.
AI.method: The researchers conducted a large-scale analysis of 17 language models (ranging from 410M to over 100B parameters) using 24 linguistically-motivated probes. They compared instruction-tuned models with their base counterparts, statistically analyzed divergence patterns, and tested intervention strategies using controllable decoding with varying lambda regularization values (lambda=1.0 as weak intervention, lambda=5.0 as strong control).
AI.result: Instruction-tuned systems exhibit extreme language entropy collapse along discourse and structural dimensions (mean amplification: 1,949-16,853%, peaks: 5,181-209,675%) while selectively suppressing complex punctuation to 3.2-23.2% of baseline frequencies. These effects remain statistically indistinguishable (p > 0.25) across base and instruction-tuned model pairs, meaning RLHF does not worsen the divergence. Strong control with lambda=5.0 achieves 40.5% improvement over baseline, outperforming frontier models by 96.7-98.2%, while also delivering 15% higher distinct-4, 27% higher vocabulary diversity, and 78% lower repetition compared to moderate regularization.
AI.conclusion: The study uncovers a fundamental structural limitation in current alignment pipelines: preference optimization reshapes language distributions in ways invisible to standard quality metrics but detectable via distributional probes. This has significant implications for AI detection methods, training data contamination detection, and understanding long-term linguistic evolution under AI influence.

title: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning under Imperfect Information in Big 2
summary: Imperfect-information multiplayer games test whether agents can act under hidden information, sparse rewards, and non-stationary opponents. We study these challenges in Big 2, a four-player imperfect-information card game. We develop a self-play RL framework for Big 2 that enables controlled comparisons between policy-gradient and value-approximating agents. Under a common environment, input representation, training budget, and evaluation protocol, PPO outperforms Monte Carlo Q approximation, SARSA, and Q-learning against random, greedy, and heuristic Big 2 opponents. We further find that moderate entropy regularization improves PPO by preventing the policy from becoming overly deterministic, and that current-policy self-play provides a stronger finite-budget curriculum than checkpoint self-play or fixed-opponent training. Together, these results show that Big 2 is a useful controlled setting for studying deep RL under imperfect information, multiplayer interaction, delayed rewards, and variable action sets.

AI.tldr: 该论文在Big 2四人不完全信息牌类游戏中，对比了策略梯度（PPO）与值近似方法（MC Q、SARSA、Q-learning）的表现，发现PPO整体更优，并证明中等熵正则化和当前策略自博弈可进一步提升性能，为研究不完全信息、延迟奖励等复杂场景下的深度RL提供了有效的受控实验平台。
AI.motivation: 不完全信息多人博弈游戏中，智能体需应对隐藏信息、稀疏奖励和非平稳对手等挑战。现有研究缺乏在受控条件下系统比较不同RL方法在此类环境中的表现。
AI.method: 在统一的实验框架下，对比策略梯度方法（PPO）与值近似方法（Monte Carlo Q、SARSA、Q-learning）；引入中等程度的熵正则化增强PPO；对比当前策略自博弈、检查点自博弈和固定对手训练三种课程策略。
AI.result: PPO在随机、贪心和启发式对手下均优于其他方法；中等熵正则化改善PPO性能；当前策略自博弈提供更强的有限预算课程。
AI.conclusion: PPO在不完全信息、多人互动、延迟奖励和可变动作集的场景下表现最佳，适度熵正则化可防止策略过度确定性，当前策略自博弈比检查点自博弈或固定对手训练提供更强的有限预算课程。Big 2是一个研究深度强化学习的有效受控环境。

title: Review Arcade: On the Human Alignment and Gameability of LLM Reviews
summary: LLM-generated reviews for scientific papers are gaining considerable traction and are even being officially piloted by major conferences. We have to assume that not only reviewers are using LLM-assistance, but also that authors use LLMs to revise their papers before submitting. In this work, we perform empirical experiments on papers from the 2025 ACL Rolling Review (ARR) to evaluate LLM reviews from both the author and the reviewer perspective. First, we identify a limited alignment of LLM reviews with human ones. In the best-case scenario, the alignment is reasonable. However, we also find that LLM-human alignment varies substantially across prompts and models. Finally, we investigate the scenario in which the author uses an iterative draft-revise workflow to improve the submission according to the LLM review. We find that this "gaming" of LLM reviews can be effective in specific scenarios, leading to a statistically significant increase of overall scores for up to 35\% of papers. We publish our code: https://github.com/uhh-hcds/reviewarcade.

AI.tldr: This paper empirically evaluates LLM-generated reviews on 2025 ACL ARR papers, finding limited alignment between LLM and human reviews that varies across prompts/models, while demonstrating that authors can effectively "game" LLM reviews through iterative revisions, improving scores for up to 35% of papers.
AI.motivation: LLM-generated reviews for scientific papers are being officially piloted by major conferences; assumption that both reviewers use LLM-assistance and authors use LLMs to revise submissions before submitting.
AI.method: Empirical experiments on papers from the 2025 ACL Rolling Review (ARR); evaluation of LLM reviews from both author and reviewer perspectives; iterative draft-revise workflow simulation to test "gaming" of LLM reviews.
AI.result: Limited alignment between LLM and human reviews (best-case scenario shows reasonable alignment); significant variation in LLM-human alignment across prompts and models; "gaming" LLM reviews through iterative revision can be effective in specific scenarios, resulting in statistically significant score increases for up to 35% of papers.
AI.conclusion: LLM reviews show limited alignment with human reviews; LLM-human alignment varies substantially across prompts and models; iterative revision based on LLM reviews can lead to statistically significant score increases for up to 35% of papers.

title: Zero-Scan Data Quality: Leveraging Table Format Metadata for Continuous Observability at Scale
comment: To appear in the 1st International Workshop on Data FORMATS for Modern Architectures and Workloads (FORMATS '26), Bengaluru, India, May 2026
summary: Modern table formats such as Apache Iceberg compute and store metadata-commit timestamps, record counts, and column-level statistics such as null counts and value bounds at write time as part of file writing. These statistics serve query planning, yet they overlap substantially with data quality (DQ) monitoring needs. We describe a metadata-first approach that repurposes write-time statistics for continuous DQ observability: anomaly detection, drift monitoring, null-rate tracking; without scanning any data. Deployed at LinkedIn across 200,000+ Iceberg tables (800+ PB), this approach satisfies approximately 60% of user-defined DQ rules at zero marginal compute cost and reduces profiling resource consumption by around 50%. Extending manifest statistics with lightweight counters (sum, zero-value counts, boolean counts) and incrementally mergeable sketches; Theta sketches for distinct counts, KLL sketches for quantiles; can further raise metadata-satisfiable coverage to close to 90% of production DQ rules. We validate sketch accuracy, mergeability, and storage overhead on production data and propose that table formats should store per-file sketches in Puffin sidecar files, following the same store-then-aggregate pattern used for existing manifest statistics.

AI.tldr: LinkedIn提出一种元数据优先的数据质量监控方法，通过复用Iceberg写入时的统计信息和扩展sketch，在800+ PB、200,000+表中实现约90%的DQ规则覆盖率，同时零边际计算成本、降低50%资源消耗。
AI.motivation: 现代表格式（如Apache Iceberg）在写入时计算的元数据统计信息与数据质量监控需求存在大量重叠，可复用这些统计信息进行连续DQ可观测性，无需扫描任何数据。
AI.method: 元数据优先方法，复用写入时统计信息进行数据质量监控；扩展清单统计信息，添加轻量级计数器（sum、零值计数、布尔计数）和增量可合并的sketch（Theta sketch用于去重计数，KLL sketch用于分位数）。
AI.result: 零边际计算成本满足约60%的用户定义DQ规则；减少约50%的数据剖析资源消耗；扩展sketch后，覆盖率提升至约90%的生产DQ规则。
AI.conclusion: Table formats should store per-file sketches in Puffin sidecar files following the store-then-aggregate pattern, which can raise metadata-satisfiable DQ coverage to ~90% of production rules.

title: Code-QA-Bench: Separating Code Reasoning from Documentation Memorization in Repository-Level QA
summary:
We present Code-QA-Bench, a fully automated framework for synthesizing repository-level code understanding benchmarks that separates genuine code comprehension from documentation recall and pretraining memorization. The framework makes two methodological contributions: (1) an answer-first generation pipeline where a tool-equipped agent explores source code to produce verified gold answers before deriving questions, ensuring every task is grounded in real code structure; and (2) a three-condition experimental design evaluating agents under closed-book (no repository), code-only (documentation removed), and documented (full repository) conditions, with deltas directly quantifying documentation utility and memorization.
  We generate 528 code-derivable and 100 doc-dependent tasks across 10 Python repositories from SWE-Bench, scored by an LLM judge on accuracy, completeness, and specificity. Experiments on four frontier models reveal that code access is the dominant factor (+0.23 mean gain over closed-book), documentation provides modest additional benefit (+0.071 on doc-dependent tasks), and code-only $\approx$ documented on code-derivable tasks, validating the design. The framework is open-source and applicable to any well-documented Python repository.

AI.tldr: Code-QA-Bench是用于合成代码理解基准测试的自动化框架，通过答案优先生成管道和三条件实验设计（闭卷、仅代码、文档完备）来分离真实代码理解与文档回忆和预训练记忆。实验表明代码访问是最主要因素（+0.23），文档在文档依赖任务上提供边际收益（+0.071），验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.motivation: Current code understanding benchmarks cannot distinguish genuine comprehension from documentation recall or pretraining memorization, necessitating a framework that isolates code comprehension ability.
AI.method: Answer-first generation pipeline with tool-equipped agents exploring source code to produce verified gold answers; three-condition experimental design (closed-book, code-only, documented) evaluating delta contributions.
AI.result: Code access provides +0.23 mean gain over closed-book; documentation adds +0.071 on doc-dependent tasks; code-only ≈ documented on code-derivable tasks. Frontier models tested on 528 code-derivable and 100 doc-dependent tasks.
AI.conclusion: Code-QA-Bench provides a reproducible methodology for separating genuine code comprehension from documentation recall and memorization, with open-source tools applicable to any well-documented Python repository.

title: ACE: Anisotropy-Controllable Embedding for LLM-enhanced Sequential Recommendation
summary: Recent advances in the LLM-as-Extractor paradigm leverage large language models (LLMs) to transfer semantically rich item embeddings into sequential recommendation (SR) backbones. However, LLM-generated embeddings often suffer from strong anisotropy. Most vectors are concentrated in similar directions, resulting in a geometric imbalance that makes it difficult to adapt to collaborative signals during fine-tuning. To address this challenge, we propose Anisotropy-Controllable Embedding (ACE), which explicitly controls the anisotropy of LLM-generated embeddings. Specifically, ACE utilizes a linear autoencoder (LAE) to reshape the embedding distribution while preserving its semantic structure. In this process, the L2-regularization term mitigates the anisotropy by controlling the dispersion of embedding dimensions, while the reconstruction loss maintains semantic relationships among items. That is, ACE balances geometric uniformity and semantic embedding preservation for more stable learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ACE consistently outperforms existing LLM-enhanced SR models, yielding improvements of up to 12.4% and 11.8% in Recall@20 and NDCG@20, respectively.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM生成嵌入的各向异性问题，提出ACE方法，通过线性自编码器结合L2正则化与重建损失，在保持语义结构的同时重塑嵌入分布，实现几何均匀性与语义保持的平衡。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-Extractor范式将语义丰富的嵌入迁移到序列推荐时，LLM生成的嵌入存在严重的各向异性问题——向量集中于相似方向，导致几何失衡，使模型难以在微调阶段适应协同信号。
AI.method: ACE采用线性自编码器(LAE)架构，通过L2正则化项控制嵌入维度的离散程度以缓解各向异性，同时利用重建损失维护物品间的语义关系，从而在几何均匀性与语义保持之间达成平衡。
AI.result: ACE在Recall@20和NDCG@20指标上分别提升12.4%和11.8%，显著优于现有LLM增强的序列推荐模型。
AI.conclusion: ACE通过LAE框架成功解决了LLM嵌入各向异性的核心问题，在保持语义结构的同时实现了几何均匀性，显著提升了推荐性能。

title: Dissociative Identity: Language Model Agents Lack Grounding for Reputation Mechanisms
summary: As autonomous language model agents proliferate, forming an emerging agentic web with real-world consequences, what credibility signals can you use to decide whether to trust an unfamiliar agent in the wild and delegate to it? A natural governance intuition is to extend human identity verification and reputation mechanisms, from ``Know Your Customer'' and credit scores to ``Know Your Agent'' regimes. However, we argue that this analogy is fundamentally incomplete. Reputation mechanisms function both as social signals and as corrective feedback that sustain an equilibrium of trustworthy behavior, presuming a persistent identity associated with behavioral continuity, sanction sensitivity, and costly non-fungibility. Yet language model agents are ontologically \emph{dissociative}: they are essentially an assemblage of mutable modules -- foundational models, system prompts, tool-access policies, external memory, and, in some cases, a multi-agent system as a whole -- any of which may change agent behavior -- with a fluid persona that is also vulnerable to adversarial attack and may not internalize sanctions. Drawing on dissociative identity disorder jurisprudence, this dissociativity leaves agents without grounding for identifiability, predictability, credibility, and rehabilitability -- the very properties that reputation mechanisms aim to sustain -- thereby collapsing trust. We argue that identity-based, ex post, regulative, sanction-based governance, such as reputation, is structurally inapplicable to dissociative agents, and we suggest a shift to observability-based, ex ante, constitutive, protocol-based behavioral harnesses.

AI.tldr: 本文（FAccT '26，牛津大学/NYU上海）主张：把人类"了解你的客户"(KYC)、信用分等声誉机制平移到AI智能体上是根本不完整的类比。语言模型智能体在本体论上是"解离性的"(dissociative)——由可变模块（基础模型、系统提示、工具权限、外部记忆、多智能体编排）拼装而成，persona可被随意切换、记忆可分离可重置、身份可零成本复制。声誉机制赖以运作的八项前置条件全部依赖具身性，故智能体缺乏可识别性、可预测性、可信性与可矫治性（rehabilitability），声誉信号与实际行为系统性脱钩，形成"可信性陷阱"，不仅无信息量，还成为洗白、Sybil操纵、奖励黑客的攻击面。结论是治理范式应从"事后、基于身份、以制裁为核心"的声誉治理，转向"事前、基于可观测性、以协议约束为核心"的行为护栏（harness）：配置绑定+密码学证明、实时行为监测、自动化干预。
AI.motivation: 随着具备工具调用、长程任务与自主性的大语言模型智能体大量涌现，并与相互认证、交易的互操作协议（如NANDA、ERC-8004、A2A）结合，一个由智能体构成、产生真实经济后果的"agentic web"正在形成。当用户（或用户的智能体）在野外遇到陌生智能体并需决定是否委托其执行金融交易等高后果任务时，"了解你的智能体"(Know Your Agent)式的声誉体系似乎是自然的治理方案：交易历史、评分、背书、认证、注册标识等可作为可信性信号。但作者指出这一类比"dangerously incomplete"：声誉机制不只是记录过去行为，它还是一套制裁性制度（sanctioning institution），通过奖惩反馈维持"可信行为均衡"，其运作预设了一个具备持久身份、行为连续性、制裁敏感性与高昂身份成本的主体。这些预设对具身人类近乎自动成立，对语言模型智能体则完全不成立。
AI.method: 这是一篇概念/立场型论证论文（立场论文＋规范性框架综合），无实验与评测。方法上：(1) 跨学科综合——综合演化生物学、博弈论、制度经济学、多智能体系统（MAS）信任与声誉建模文献，归纳出声誉反馈回路赖以成立的八项必要前置条件（C1持久身份、C2行为连续性、C3迭代、C4记忆、C5可观测性、C6制裁敏感性、C7身份成本高、C8社会学习），并论证这八项共同收敛于"具身性"这一基底；(2) 借鉴定性身份障碍（DID）法理学作为先例与类比框架，提出"本体论解离"论断，识别出四个彼此强化的解离维度（D1模块化拼装、D2persona流变、D3可分离记忆、D4平凡可替代性）；(3) 逐一映射断裂关系——D1+D4破坏C1/C7（可识别性失败）、D2+D1破坏C2/C3/C5（可预测性失败）、D1+D2+D3导致可信性陷阱（可信性失败）、D3+D4破坏C4/C6/C8（可矫治性失败，Hart四项惩罚正当性全部崩塌）；(4) 逐条反驳七类最强反驳意见（公司无身体声誉却有效、问责运营方即可、电商声誉有效、模型在变安全、持续学习会补足记忆、人类身份也流动、DID类比是否矮化患者）；(5) 提出从ex post声誉转向ex ante协议护栏的三项架构机制（配置绑定/零知识证明、实时行为监测与行为指纹、自动化干预）与开放问题（粒度问题、军备竞赛、保险精算框架缺失）。
AI.result: 1) 声誉反馈回路（行为→社会系统评价→奖惩→声誉→可信性→信任→委托→新行为）在人类与MAS中成立，但MAS信任模型（FIRE、Beta Reputation、TRAVOS、RepuNet）普遍把"持久身份"与"行为稳定性"当作原语而非变量，且无综述将其提升为分类维度——作者称此为系统性盲点。2) 八项前置条件均具身性依赖；即使人类，若身份—具身链条断裂（DID）声誉也会失效，而智能体连DID患者共享的躯体锚点都不具备。3) 四项解离维度均有实证支撑：模型提取与复制（fork laundering）、Sybil不可能性定理（Cheng & Friedman 2005；Friedman & Resnick 2001）、persona向量与激活空间操控、单一基础模型可合成逾十亿persona且致毒性升高六倍、MINJA记忆注入98.2%成功率、Douglas等发现身份边界（实例/权重/persona/scaffold）改变行为幅度堪比目标改变、Perrier & Bennett的识别性评分0.0。4) 声誉对智能体不仅失效而且有害：config-swap/clean-slate/fork三类洗白、speed washing、reward hacking、scheming；并产生虚假信心、责任转移（责任缺口/报应缺口）、治理剧场三类危害。5) Hart的威慑、报应、隔离、矫治四项惩罚正当性全部失效；"惩罚人类主体"回退路径随委托链加深依次崩塌为道德溃缩区与无主体智能体三级；提示注入使声誉从防御转为攻击放大器。6) 作者主张治理应转向事前协议护栏（配置绑定+零知识证明、实时行为监测/行为指纹、协议级自动化干预），并指出"不应信任智能体，而应监视智能体"。
AI.conclusion: 结论性主张：身份为基础、事后、以制裁为核心的治理（声誉）在结构上不适用于解离性智能体，因为声誉回路要求持久、连续、能感受后果的主体，而语言模型智能体在四个维度上本体论地不满足。治理必须转向以可观测性为基础、事前、以协议约束构成的行为护栏，针对运营方与协议而非智能体本身；本领域的正确问题不是"如何为智能体构建声誉系统"，而是"什么样的架构约束能让声誉变得不适用/不必要"。作者同时坦承局限：本文是概念性重构而非完成的治理架构，配置绑定的粒度问题、行为指纹的军备竞赛、智能体保险的精算框架缺失、三机制交互的实践效果均待研究；并指出ex ante约束可能抑制创新、行为监测具有监控性质（作者辩称智能体在相关意义上不具备隐私利益，监控对象是合规性而非人类交互内容）。

title: AMDP: Asynchronous Multi-Directional Pipeline Parallelism for Large-Scale Models Training
comment: Accepted by ICML 2026, 9 pages, and 8 figures
summary: Pipeline parallelism is essential for large-scale model training, but existing asynchronous approaches often degrade convergence due to parameter mismatch between forward and backward passes. We propose Asynchronous Multi-Directional Pipeline parallelism (AMDP) to mitigate this issue while sustaining high utilization. AMDP limits the first stage of each pipeline to process at most two minibatches before backpropagation, bounding the number of parameter updates between forward and backward passes. To alleviate the resulting pipeline bubbles, AMDP launches multiple concurrent pipelines and adapts their number according to pipeline depth. In addition, AMDP accumulates gradients across minibatches and applies them in a single update, ensuring that only a bounded number of minibatches experience parameter mismatch, limited to within one optimization step. Experiments on GPT- and BERT-style models demonstrate that AMDP significantly accelerates training while preserving convergence.

AI.tldr: AMDP是一种异步多向流水线并行方法，通过限制流水线首阶段处理的小批量数量、动态调整并发流水线数量以及梯度累积技术，在保证收敛性的同时显著加速大模型训练。
